newsitem.title: HONG KONG: New World Dev increases bond issue.
newsitem.headline: New World Dev increases bond issue.

text.p: New World Development Co Ltd said on Friday it would raise to US$350 million the sum of its 4.0 percent mandatorily convertible bond issue launched in mid-October from US$300 million to cover over-allotment.
The company had granted HSBC Investment Bank Asia Ltd, on behalf of managers of the issue, an option to subscribe for up to a further US$50 million bonds to cover over-allotment.
HSBC had notified the company that it would exercise the option in full, it said in a statement.
All the bonds are expected to be issued on the same terms, the company added. -- HONG KONG NEWSROOM (852) 2843 6369
